svg.title: Observation contract: frozen policy R under three target-rendering treatments
svg.desc: (a) Only the observation contract changes; detector, frozen policy R, task and seeds are fixed. (b) Capture by treatment, 3 seeds x 2049 episodes: mesh shaded minus analytic −48.967 pp, 95% CI [−50.113, −47.821], verdict MATERIAL_LOSS. CAUSALITY NOT TESTED: no renderer property was isolated as the cause. Checkpoint: policy R, frozen ref5in D1 ep1900 at 70 bars, not the ep25000 policy F used by the other figures. Unit of inference: paired evaluation seed.
